Problem Statement:
Given an array arr[] and a number K where K is smaller than the size of array, the task is to find the Kth smallest element in the given array. It is given that all array elements are NOT distinct.
input_spec: The first line of input contains an integer T, denoting the number of test cases. Then T test cases follow. Each test case consists of three lines. First line of each test case contains an integer N denoting size of the array. Second line contains N space separated integer denoting elements of the array. Third line of the test case contains an integer K.
output_spec: Corresponding to each test case, print the desired output in a new line.
